run_references_cli: run the references CLI tool to print TCV reference values for a given reference type
run_print_ref: run print_ref to display step number and reference field values for a named array
run_main_loop: run the main loop to step through reference timesteps and print values at a given frequency
review_print_ref: review the print_ref function that formats and prints named array reference values per step
review_main: review the main function that validates flags and iterates reference steps with frequency control
